import ee, math, sys
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
center = ee.Geometry.Point([31.55, 6.21])  # [lon, lat]
geom = center.buffer(50000).bounds()       # 50 km buffer box (rectangular bounds)

        start = ee.Date(date_str).advance(-window_days, 'day')

        return start, end

    for wd in [3, 10, 20, 30]:
        start, end = date_window(date_str, wd)
        base = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
                .filterBounds(geom)
                .filterDate(start, end))
        base_n = base.size().getInfo()

        iw = base.filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
        iw_n = iw.size().getInfo()

        # Prefer IW if available, else use base
        col0 = iw if iw_n and iw_n > 0 else base

        vv_col = col0.filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
        vh_col = col0.filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VH'))
        vv_n = vv_col.size().getInfo()
        vh_n = vh_col.size().getInfo()

        band = None
        if vv_n and vv_n > 0:
            col = vv_col
            band = 'VV'
        elif vh_n and vh_n > 0:
            col = vh_col
            band = 'VH'
        else:
            # No usable polarization in this window, try next window
            print(f"{label}: ±{wd}d base={base_n}, IW={iw_n}, VV=0, VH=0")
            continue

        n = col.size().getInfo()
        print(f"{label}: ±{wd}d base={base_n}, IW={iw_n}, VV={vv_n}, VH={vh_n}, used={band}, imgs={n}")
        if n == 0:
            continue

        # 3. Composite with union-of-masks
        comp = col.sort('system:time_start').mosaic().select(band)  # already in dB
        # Keep native mask (footprint)

        # 3a. Valid pixel count
        valid_count = comp.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=geom, scale=scale_m, maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(band).getInfo()
        if (valid_count is None) or int(valid_count) == 0:
            # Try wider window
            continue

        # 4. Water classification with dB thresholds
        thr = -17.0 if band == 'VV' else -22.0
        water = comp.lt(thr)

        # Water pixel count
        water_count = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(water).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=scale_m, maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('constant').getInfo() or 0

        # Areas (km2)
        area_img = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).rename('a')
        valid_km2 = area_img.updateMask(comp.mask()).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=scale_m, maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('a').getInfo()
        water_km2 = area_img.updateMask(water).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=scale_m, maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('a').getInfo() or 0.0

        return {'n': n, 'wd': wd, 'band': band,
                'valid_px': int(valid_count), 'water_px': int(water_count),
                'valid_km2': valid_km2, 'water_km2': water_km2}
    # No images in any window or no valid pixels after all attempts
    return {'n': 0, 'wd': None, 'band': None, 'valid_px': 0, 'water_px': 0, 'valid_km2': None, 'water_km2': None}
